description:
U by Urbeo proudly presents U Drogheda, a new development of 2 & 3-bedroom apartments located in Bryanstown, Drogheda.

These beautifully designed homes combine modern suburban living with excellent connectivity, offering comfort, convenience and style.

Property Features:

- A rated energy efficient apartments
- Spacious 2 & 3-bedroom layouts
- Generous walk-in storage in all units
- Interiors designed by Ventura Design
- High-quality finishes throughout
- Bright, well-proportioned living spaces

Location Highlights:

- Short distance to Drogheda Town Centre
- Excellent selection of boutiques, high street stores, cafés, restaurants & bars
- Wide range of local sports clubs including rowing, GAA, soccer, badminton & tennis
- Close to world-class golf courses
- Located on the south side of Drogheda
- Easy access to Dublin via excellent commuter links

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
